newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Rouble o/n rates lower after T-bill sales, qtr-end.
newsitem.headline: Rouble o/n rates lower after T-bill sales, qtr-end.

text.p: Rouble overnight credit rates eased from early levels on Wednesday as banks sought roubles less actively after setting aside funds for government securities sales and making quarter-end payments, dealers said.
Today the finance ministry is auctioning seven trillion roubles of 203-day GKO discount Treasury bills (series 22079) and four trillion roubles of 728-day OFZ government interest-bearing bonds.
roubles/dollar Apr 2 midday Apr 2 early Apr 1 close
"Rouble demand is visibly lower as banks have stopped seeking funds for the auctions and quarter and month-end payments," one dealer said.
United Investment Bank chief dealer Alexander Suchkov said banks found it more attractive to invest funds in dollar overnight credits, given the cheapness of those in roubles.
